facts.statement: The type specimen of Eshanosaurus was found in the Lower Lufeng Formation in Yunnan, China, and dates to the Hettangian stage.
facts.quote: The type specimen, consisting of three fragments of a fossilized left lower jaw and teeth, was uncovered in the Dull Purplish Beds of the Lower Lufeng Formation in Yunnan, dating to Hettangian stage.

facts.statement: Eshanosaurus was described by Xu Xing, Xijin Zhao, and James M. Clark in 2001.
facts.quote: The type species, Eshanosaurus deguchiianus, was described by Xu Xing, Xijin Zhao, and James M. Clark in 2001.

facts.statement: Eshanosaurus lived during the Early Jurassic, approximately 196 million years ago, in what is now Asia.
facts.quote: que vivió a principios del período Jurásico, hace aproximadamente 196 millones de años en el Hettangiense, en lo que es hoy Asia.

facts.statement: The holotype fossil measures about 11 centimeters in length, with an estimated total lower jaw length of 17 centimeters, though this estimate is uncertain due to damage.
facts.quote: El holotipo tiene una longitud de unos 11 centímetros, a partir de los cuales se estima una longitud total de la mandíbula inferior de 17 centímetros, aunque eso es muy incierto, ya que tanto el borde anterior como el borde posterior esán rotos.

facts.statement: Based on the fossil, Eshanosaurus is estimated to have been a relatively small animal about 3 meters in length.
facts.quote: Por lo tanto, es un animal relativamente pequeño de aproximadamente 3 metros de longitud.

facts.statement: Eshanosaurus had serrated, leaf-shaped teeth with round roots and interdental plates, indicating it was a herbivore.
facts.quote: está engastada con una gran cantidad de dientes serrados en forma de hoja con raíces redondas y placas interdentales que indican que era herbívoro.

facts.statement: The constriction between the tooth crown and root in Eshanosaurus covers part of the root, a feature not found in basal sauropodomorphs.
facts.quote: La constricción entre la corona dental y el cuello del diente también cubre parte del cuello, para los sauropodomorfos basales, se encuentra solo en la parte de la corona.

facts.statement: A wide shelf-like border on the outside of the tooth row indicates the presence of fleshy cheeks in Eshanosaurus.
facts.quote: hay un borde ancho en forma de meseta en el exterior de la hilera de dientes. Tal borde indica la presencia de mejillas carnosas.

facts.statement: Eshanosaurus may be a therizinosaurian, and if so, it would be the earliest known coelurosaur.
facts.quote: It may be a therizinosaurian, and if so the earliest known coelurosaur.

facts.statement: Some scientists doubt the classification of Eshanosaurus as a therizinosauroid due to the long chronological gap in the fossil record implied by this interpretation.
facts.quote: Due to the unusually long chronological gap in the therizinosauroid and coelurosaurian fossil record or ghost lineage created by this interpretation of the find, a few scientists have expressed doubts about the classification of Eshanosaurus as a therizinosauroid.

facts.statement: Paul M. Barrett concluded that Eshanosaurus is a therizinosaur and that its presence in the Early Jurassic implies large gaps in the coelurosaur fossil record.
facts.quote: Barrett concluded by agreeing with the original interpretation, that Eshanosaurus is a therizinosaur, and that its presence in the early Jurassic has important implications for the evolutionary history of coelurosaurs, notably, that large portions of the coelurosaur fossil record remain missing.

facts.statement: Sues and Averianov (2016) considered the therizinosaurian affinities of Eshanosaurus to be problematic.
facts.quote: Sues and Averianov (2016) considered the putative therizinosaurian affinites of Eshanosaurus to be problematic.

facts.statement: Eshanosaurus is classified within the infraorder Therizinosauria.
facts.quote: infraordo: Therizinosauria

facts.statement: Eshanosaurus belongs to the family Therizinosauridae.
facts.quote: familia: Therizinosauridae

facts.statement: The species Eshanosaurus deguchiianus was described by Xu, Zhao, and Clark in 2001.
facts.quote: La especie tipo, Eshanosaurus deguchiianus, fue descrita por Xu, Zhao y Clark en 2001.

facts.statement: The generic name Eshanosaurus is derived from Eshan, and the specific name honors Hikaru Deguchi, who convinced Xu to study dinosaurs.
facts.quote: El nombre genérico se deriva de Eshan, el nombre específico honra a Hikaru Deguchi, quien convenció a Xu de que debía estudiar dinosaurios.

facts.statement: The type specimen, consisting of three fragments of a lower jaw and fossilized teeth, was discovered in the Dull Purplish bed of the lower portion of the Lufeng Formation in Yunnan.
facts.quote: El espécimen tipo , que consta de tres fragmentos de una mandíbula inferior y dientes fosilizados , se descubrió en a cama Dull Purplish de la porción más baja de la Formación Lufeng, en Yunnan

facts.statement: The fossils date to approximately 196 million years ago during the Hettangian stage.
facts.quote: que datan de aproximadamente 196 millones de años durante la etapa Hettangiana.

facts.statement: The specimen is housed in the collection of the Institute of Vertebrate Paleontology and Paleoanthropology in Beijing, cataloged under accession number IVPP V11579.
facts.quote: El espécimen se encuentra en la colección del Instituto de Paleontología y Paleoantropología de Vertebrados en Beijing, donde está catalogado bajo el número de acceso IVPP V11579.

facts.statement: The authors place Eshanosaurus in the family Therizinosauridae based on three distinctive synapomorphies.
facts.quote: Los autores ubican a Eshanosaurus en la familia Therizinosauridae en base de tres distintivas sinapormorfias.

facts.statement: It is the first known Coelurosauria and an advanced maniraptoran living before Archaeopteryx.
facts.quote: Est lo hace el primer Coelurosauria conocido, y un avanzado maniraptor viviendo antes que Archaeopteryx.

facts.statement: The authors who initially described the fossil classified Eshanosaurus as a member of Therizinosauroidea based on six distinctive features of the jaw and teeth.
facts.quote: Los autores que inicialmente describieron el fósil, clasificaron a Eshanosaurus como un miembro de la Therizinosauroidea con base en seis características distintivas de la mandíbula y los dientes

facts.statement: This makes it a coelurosaurian, a maniraptor that lived much earlier than Archaeopteryx, 60 million years before other basal therizinosaurs like Falcarius and Beipiaosaurus.
facts.quote: lo que lo convierte en un celurosauriano, un maniraptor que vivió mucho antes que el Archaeopteryx, 60 millones de años antes que otros tericinosaurianos basales como Falcarius y Beipiaosaurus.

facts.statement: Due to the unusually long chronological gap in the fossil record of therizinosaurs and coelurosaurs, some scientists have expressed doubts about the classification of Eshanosaurus as a therizinosaur.
facts.quote: Debido a la brecha cronológica inusualmente larga en el registro fósil de los tericinosauriano y celurosaurianos un linaje de fantasmas creado por esta interpretación del hallazgo, algunos científicos han expresado dudas sobre la clasificación de Eshanosaurus como tericinosauriano.

facts.statement: James Kirkland and D. G. Wolfe reported in personal correspondence that the teeth of Eshanosaurus had a medial crest seen only in prosauropods or basal Sauropodomorpha.
facts.quote: James Kirkland y D. G. Wolfe, en su artículo de 2001 que describe el tericinosáurido Nothronychus, relataron en la correspondencia personal de que los dientes de Eshanosaurus tenían una cresta medial que solo se veía en los prosauropodos o Sauropodomorpha basales.

facts.statement: Barrett concluded, in agreement with the original interpretation, that Eshanosaurus is a therizinosaurid and that its presence in the Early Jurassic has important implications for the evolutionary history of coelurosaurs.
facts.quote: Barrett concluyó de acuerdo con la interpretación original, que Eshanosaurus es un tericinosáurido, y que su presencia en el Jurásico temprano tiene implicaciones importantes para la historia evolutiva de los celurosaurianos

facts.statement: The time range for Eshanosaurus is from 201.4 to 199.5 million years ago during the Hettangian.
facts.quote: Time range: Hettangian to Hettangian (201.4 to 199.5 million years ago)

rejected.statement: Researchers James Kirkland and D.G. Wolfe suggested that the teeth of Eshanosaurus bore a medial ridge seen only in prosauropods or basal sauropodomorphs.
rejected.quote: James Kirkland and D.G. Wolfe, in their 2001 paper describing the therizinosaur Nothronychus, related personal correspondence that the teeth of Eshanosaurus bore a medial ridge only seen in prosauropods or basal Sauropodomorpha.
rejected.reason: statement copies the source wording: 'the teeth of Eshanosaurus bore a medial ridge'
